words.definition: to come before something else in time or order
words.example: A short training video precedes the actual safety drill.
words.exampleTranslation: 在正式的安全演習之前，會先播放一段簡短的訓練影片。
words.note: 相關詞：precedent (n.) 先例，例如 set a precedent（開先例）

words.definition: a person or thing that takes the place of another
words.example: HR is still interviewing candidates for a replacement for the retiring manager.
words.exampleTranslation: 人資部門還在面試即將退休經理的替代人選。
words.note: 動詞形：replace (v.) 取代，例如 We need to replace the broken printer

words.definition: to eat dinner, especially in a formal or restaurant setting
words.example: The clients will dine with us at a nearby restaurant tonight.
words.exampleTranslation: 今晚客戶會跟我們在附近的餐廳一起用餐。
words.note: 常用片語 dine out（外出用餐）

words.definition: an official government document allowing travel to other countries
words.example: Make sure your passport is valid for at least six more months.
words.exampleTranslation: 請確認你的護照至少還有六個月的有效期。
words.note: 常見於 passport control（護照查驗）這個複合詞

words.definition: a person who works with you at the same company
words.example: One of my coworkers is organizing the retirement party.
words.exampleTranslation: 我有一位同事正在籌辦這場退休歡送會。
words.note: 字首 co- 表示「共同」，同樣用法還有 cooperate（合作）、coexist（共存）

words.definition: happening or expected soon
words.example: Details about the upcoming product launch will be shared next week.
words.exampleTranslation: 關於即將到來的產品發表，詳情將於下週公布。
words.note: 相關詞：片語 come up 表示「即將發生」，upcoming 語意即由此而來

words.definition: a piece of furniture with shelves or drawers used for storage
words.example: Extra office supplies are kept in the cabinet by the printer.
words.exampleTranslation: 多餘的辦公用品放在印表機旁的櫃子裡。
words.note: 政治情境中，(the) cabinet 可指政府的「內閣」

words.definition: a device or machine, typically for household use
words.example: The office kitchen was recently equipped with a new appliance.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室茶水間最近添購了一台新的家電。
words.note: 常見於 household appliance（家電用品）這個片語

words.definition: serving to explain something
words.example: An explanatory note was attached to clarify the revised budget.
words.exampleTranslation: 附上了一張說明性的便條，用來釐清修訂後的預算。
words.note: 常見於 self-explanatory（不言自明的）這個複合詞

words.definition: a person who teaches a practical skill or subject
words.example: The fitness instructor leads a class every Tuesday evening.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位健身教練每週二晚上都會帶一堂課。
words.note: 動詞形：instruct (v.) 指導；命令，例如 The manual instructs users to restart the device

words.definition: a set of keys used to input text into a computer
words.example: IT replaced her broken keyboard the same day she reported it.
words.exampleTranslation: 資訊部門在她通報的當天就更換了她壞掉的鍵盤。
words.note: 常見於 keyboard shortcut（鍵盤快捷鍵）這個複合詞

words.definition: the organizations and channels used to communicate news and information to the public
words.example: The company invited local media to cover the grand opening.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司邀請了當地媒體來報導開幕典禮。
words.note: 文法：media 原為 medium 的複數形，但現代英文常當作單數集合名詞使用

words.definition: a large self-service store selling food and household goods
words.example: The new supermarket opened just down the street from the office.
words.exampleTranslation: 新開的超市就在辦公室街尾。
words.note: 字首 super- 表示「超越、在……之上」，同樣用法還有 supervisor（主管）

words.definition: legally or officially acceptable at the present time
words.example: Your parking permit is valid until the end of the year.
words.exampleTranslation: 你的停車證有效期到今年年底。
words.note: 反義詞：valid（有效的）前面加上否定字首 in- 就變成 invalid

words.definition: permission to enter a place, or the fee charged for entry
words.example: Admission to the trade show is free with online registration.
words.exampleTranslation: 只要線上完成報名，貿易展的入場就是免費的。
words.note: 動詞形：admit (v.) 准許進入；承認，例如 She was admitted to the hospital

words.definition: a portable computer that can be used on one's lap
words.example: Please bring your company laptop to the offsite meeting.
words.exampleTranslation: 請攜帶你的公司筆電參加外部會議。
words.note: 由 lap（大腿）+ top（上方）組成，因為使用時通常放在腿上

words.definition: to draw a line under a word or phrase to emphasize it
words.example: She underlined the deadline in red so no one would miss it.
words.exampleTranslation: 她用紅筆把截止日期畫底線，確保沒人會漏看。
words.note: 也常用於抽象意義，表示「強調」而非只是畫線，例如 underline the importance of safety

words.definition: relating to or powered by electricity
words.example: An electrical issue caused the office lights to flicker.
words.exampleTranslation: 電力問題導致辦公室的燈忽明忽暗。
words.note: electric 多指「由電力驅動的」特定裝置（electric car），electrical 則指較廣泛的「與電相關」概念（electrical engineer）

words.definition: a powered flying vehicle with fixed wings
words.example: Our airplane was delayed by two hours due to weather.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們搭的飛機因天氣因素延誤了兩小時。
words.note: airplane 是美式用法，英式英文通常說 aeroplane

words.definition: a task or piece of work given to someone
words.example: Her next assignment is to lead the overseas expansion project.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的下一個任務是主導海外擴張專案。
words.note: 動詞形：assign (v.) 指派，例如 The manager assigned her a new project
